raw_text: More details emerging on the Pune Smart City IoT attack. The exposed MQTT broker had no authentication, completely open to the internet. Attackers sent malicious commands to 2,000+ streetlights and 150 traffic controllers. The lack of basic security on critical urban infrastructure is alarming. PMC has disconnected everything and ordered a full audit. Several smart city vendors being questioned.
clean_text: Pune IoT attack details: MQTT broker had zero authentication. Attackers sent malicious commands to thousands of devices. PMC disconnected all systems, vendors questioned.
